confirmed_errors.why_decisive: Clause 14 is itself written permission concerning the named company. The supplied material does not establish whether the actual occupation was exactly the authorized sharing, later changed into something materially different, or involved legal possession beyond that permission. The adverse lower-court result is procedurally established, but its reasoning and factual basis are absent. N1 therefore converts an unexplained prior finding into proof that the actual transaction fell outside the written permission.
